options.name: Amazing Inspiration
options.benefit: Increase the inspiration die to d8 and later d10.

options.name: Combat Inspiration
options.benefit: Spend inspiration on attack and damage rolls at reduced cost.

options.name: Device Talent
options.benefit: Use inspiration on Use Magic Device checks without spending points.

options.name: Effortless Aid
options.benefit: Aid another as a move action, or a swift action by spending inspiration.

options.name: Empathy
options.benefit: Use inspiration on Heal and Sense Motive without spending points.

options.name: Expanded Inspiration
options.benefit: Use inspiration on Diplomacy, Heal, Perception, Profession, and Sense Motive without spending points.

options.name: Inspired Alertness
options.benefit: Spend inspiration to avoid being caught flat-footed.

options.name: Item Lore
options.benefit: Use inspiration on Appraise and Use Magic Device without spending points.

options.name: Quick Study
options.benefit: Study an opponent as a swift action.

options.name: Sickening Offensive
options.benefit: A studied strike can sicken its target.

options.name: Underworld Inspiration
options.benefit: Use inspiration on Bluff, Disable Device, Disguise, Intimidate, and Sleight of Hand without spending points.

options.name: Evasion
options.benefit: Take no damage on a successful qualifying Reflex save.

options.name: Tenacious Inspiration
options.benefit: Roll two inspiration dice and take the higher result.
